story.fullStory:
P.o.d's "Goodbye For Now" reached #48 on the Billboard Hot 100. and the lead single from their sixth studio album, Testify, released in 2006.

The song peaked at #48 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 2 weeks on the chart.

Goodbye For Now was released in 2006.

P.O.D.
(an initialism for Payable on Death) is an American Christian nu metal band formed in 1992 and based in San Diego, California.
The band's line-up consists of vocalist Paul Joshua "Sonny" Sandoval, bassist Mark "Traa" Daniels, lead guitarist Marcos Curiel, and drummer Noah "Wuv" Bernardo.
They have sold over 12 million records worldwide.
